method: Reuse existing portrait records, exact Commons API file/search metadata, official biographies, family archive, award catalogues, press photo galleries and institutional portrait pages. Source identity is based on caption/context, never identifying an unnamed person by facial recognition.

limits: Research-only candidate set, not 14 cleared assets.

No outreach, purchases, image edits, production assets, article or public site changes.
